title: Outcomes
description: Captain-declared desired outcomes with measurable criteria

deployment.description: Optional deployment gate: when set, only the cabinet whose CABINET_ID matches this value compiles the file. Prevents a git-tracked live mission file from being compiled (and its tasks double-executed) by other deployments pulling the same branch.

description.description: Longer description of the desired outcome

oneOf.description: Simple criterion — compiler infers role, dependencies, and defaults the other v2 fields
Rich criterion with Mission Compiler v2 fields. 'title' (or 'description') is required.

node_id.description: Explicit node id; auto-generated when omitted

measurable_criteria.description: Concrete criteria to determine if outcome is achieved. Each item can be a simple string OR a rich Mission Compiler v2 object.

ratified_at.description: ISO 8601 date or datetime when captain ratified

ratified_by.description: The literal actor the ratifying door could support: 'captain' for an authenticated door (web, chat), 'operator' for the terminal door, which is attribution rather than authentication.

ratified_via.description: Which door the tap came through. Agnostic by construction — the adapter's name, if any, rides in the event's principal.

ratified_from_digest.description: The proposed_digest of the row AS PROPOSED, carried onto the ratified copy so the two files can be compared later.

proposed_digest.description: Digest of the row as the proposing organ wrote it (framework.onboarding.genesis). Its presence on a ratified row is what makes 'edited since proposed' answerable.

edited_since_proposed.description: True when the row's content no longer matches its recorded proposed_digest at ratification time — i.e. somebody edited the card before it was ratified.
